items.item: Frame loop that costs little when nothing happens
items.evidence: src/components/face/driver.ts: one requestAnimationFrame loop, 12 frames a second asleep, stopped by the browser when the tab is hidden. It does not stop while the face is awake and still: breath and saccade always move it. The solver measures about 0.5 ms a frame under Bun; no browser frame cost was measured

items.evidence: src/lib/face/layers.ts; src/lib/face/face.test.ts 'rig'

items.item: No program can make a spring unstable
items.evidence: src/lib/face/layers.ts MAX_OMEGA, SNAP_MS; src/lib/face/face.test.ts 'no move, however abrupt, sends a spring off to infinity'

items.item: Steps: to, by, wave, wait, seq, par, stagger, repeat, vary, look, feature, go, burst, use, release; values as numbers, seeded draws or arguments; keep
items.evidence: src/lib/face/program.ts; src/lib/face/face.test.ts 'compile'

items.item: A program is checked before it starts; a refusal gives the step's path, the reason and the nearest name; limits on length, cues, depth, repeats and uses; clamps reported
items.evidence: src/lib/face/program.ts compile, LIMITS; src/lib/face/face.test.ts 'a refusal says where and why', 'a program cannot run for ever'. The check is a compiler written here, not zod over a JSON Schema

items.item: A score plays on a layer; a newer one interrupts; kept holds stay until the layer is stopped or played on; endings are recorded and awaited
items.evidence: src/lib/face/player.ts; src/lib/face/face.test.ts 'a new performance interrupts the one before it', 'idle long enough it sleeps'
